saw_lines: Fashion buyers check fit first, then ask how fast it arrives and whether a return is easy before they click.
So the sale is lost in the first line if delivery is not answered before the buyer clicks away.
Your site explains how orders ship, yet none of your 30 ads mention it. Put delivery in the first line of new ads for new buyers this week.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 19 Oct 2026
points: Your site explains how orders ship, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping, so a new buyer must leave the ad to decide. Put delivery time and the country in the first line of new ads for new buyers.
None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a buyer sees a collection and no sign that others chose it. Collect a number, a review count or orders shipped, and open new ads with it on the image.

2 of 21 ads are creator posts run from the JOOP! brand page, so a shopper sees a brand ad where a personal recommendation should be. Whitelist them from the creator account and cut a few variations of each.
0 of 21 ads carry an offer or discount, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Put a first order offer or a bundle on the creative of new ads and repeat it in the copy.

ads_1: New season creative that answers delivery and opens with a first order offer
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
